name: visualize-sh
description: Interactive knowledge graph of the structural heart landscape (valvular and non-valvular): conditions, therapies, companies, and clinical trials.

scripts.build:data: npm run build:graph && npm run build:intelligence
scripts.newsletter:render: npm run newsletter:validate && node --import tsx scripts/render-newsletter.ts
scripts.newsletter:review: npm run newsletter:validate && node --import tsx scripts/render-newsletter.ts --review
scripts.newsletter:delivery:check: npm run newsletter:validate && node --import tsx scripts/check-newsletter-delivery.ts
scripts.newsletter:validate: npm run build:data && npm run test:newsletter && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm run security:check
scripts.validate:local: npm run build:data && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm test && npm run security:check && npm run newsletter:local -- --dry-run
scripts.review:prepare: npm run build:intelligence && node --import tsx scripts/review-evidence.ts
